description:
You are a Facilities Coordinator. A bare architectural floor plan for the 3rd floor of Building C has been provided in '~/Diagrams/3rd_floor_plan.drawio'. Your task is to transform this into a compliant Emergency Evacuation Plan based on the safety requirements document located at '~/Desktop/evacuation_plan_requirements.txt'.

REQUIRED ACTIONS:
1. Read the requirements file to understand room names and safety equipment locations.
2. Label all 15+ rooms according to the Room Schedule (e.g., '301 - Executive Office', 'Server Room', etc.).
3. Add 'EXIT' labels (red text/shape) at the 3 specified exit locations.
4. Place Fire Extinguisher symbols (red) and First Aid Stations (green) at the required locations.
5. Draw Primary Evacuation Routes (solid green arrows) and Secondary Routes (dashed orange arrows) from rooms to exits.
6. Add an 'Assembly Point' annotation outside the building.
7. Create a Legend/Key box explaining the symbols.
8. Add the Title: '3rd Floor Emergency Evacuation Plan — Building C'.
9. Export the final diagram as a PDF to '~/Diagrams/3rd_floor_evacuation.pdf'.

IMPORTANT: Dismiss any 'Update Available' dialogs on startup. Use the draw.io shapes library to find suitable symbols (rectangles, arrows, etc.) if specific icons are not immediately visible.
